NAME: AHB to APB bridge APB fabric and shim verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-AHB2APB-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Convert AHB-Lite transfers in the APB region to APB3 transfers.
details: Convert AHB-Lite transfers in the APB region to APB3 transfers.
implementation_note: Source: Protocol

NAME: t_apb_protocol
details: Oracle: APB3 protocol checker, zero violations
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv, checks APB: PSEL one-hot, PENABLE only after a 1-cycle SETUP, and APB slave models saw no protocol error - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Since 2026-10-03 the independent APB protocol checker tb/common/apb_checker.v (ten rules, own self-test of 35 checks) is also bound on the four modelled windows and on both sides of the shim: 0 violations.

NAME: t_apb_rw
details: Oracle: word read and write to every window Coverage goal: all 11 windows
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv reads and writes windows 1, 5, 9 and 11 (4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression); the other windows are reached only at chip level, where sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c accesses every window (RESULT: PASSED).

NAME: R-2 Decode eleven 4 KiB windows.
details: Decode eleven 4 KiB windows.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0008, 0020

NAME: t_apb_decode
details: Oracle: every haddr[15:12] value hits the right window or errors Coverage goal: all 16
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv drives 7 of the 16 haddr[15:12] values: windows 1, 5, 9, 11 mapped, 0 and 0xC unmapped, 3 masked - 6 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-3 Peripherals shall be clocked at 125 MHz not 250 MHz to halve ...
details: Peripherals shall be clocked at 125 MHz, not 250 MHz, to halve peripheral-domain dynamic power.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0002

NAME: t_apb_pclk_rate
details: Oracle: peripherals observe 125 MHz
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv, check t_pclk_div2: pclk = hclk/2 (8 ns) - PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Not checked in the bridge bench.

NAME: R-4 No clock-domain-crossing synchronisers shall be required between ...
details: No clock-domain-crossing synchronisers shall be required between hclk and pclk, and the reason shall be stated as a checkable property rather than asserted.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0002

NAME: t_apb_no_cdc
details: Oracle: a_capture_stable_at_phase + a_pclk_on_hclk over 10⁶ cycles
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - neither property exists as an assertion (a_capture_stable_at_phase is named in a comment at rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_bridge.v:45) and no long run checks them. Indirect evidence only: 8 back-to-back writes all land (BRG-1) in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv.

NAME: R-5 The APB access rate shall be a per-window parameter so an IP with ...
details: The APB access rate shall be a per-window parameter, so an IP with a lower maximum frequency can be accommodated without a second clock.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0002

NAME: t_apb_div
details: Oracle: each APB_DIV value stretches ACCESS correctly Coverage goal: all 4 values
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv runs APB_DIV /1 and /2 (window 11, a_apb_div: PENABLE held 2 pclk) - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression; the plan asks for all 4 values.

NAME: R-6 Byte and halfword accesses shall be rejected with an error not ...
details: Byte and halfword accesses shall be rejected with an error, not silently widened.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_apb_subword
details: Oracle: BYTE and HALF rejected, no APB transfer generated Coverage goal: both sizes × 4 offsets
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv, checks [N-7.12] byte and halfword rejected with ERROR and no APB transfer for any of them - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. With the core: sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c takes a precise fault on a sub-word access (RESULT: PASSED). The 2 sizes x 4 offsets cross is not swept.

NAME: R-7 A peripheral that never asserts PREADY shall not hang the bus.
details: A peripheral that never asserts PREADY shall not hang the bus.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_apb_timeout
details: Oracle: stuck PREADY → ERROR at 16 cycles, bus recovers Coverage goal: each window
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv, checks [N-7.15] 16-pclk PREADY timeout gives ERROR and the bus is usable afterwards - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression; one window, not each window.

NAME: t_apb_no_hang
details: Oracle: a_no_hang under a randomly stalling peripheral model
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv, checks a_no_hang (bus usable after a timeout) and 3 APB wait states give OKAY - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression; the peripheral model stalls for fixed counts, not randomly.

NAME: R-8 An access to an unmapped window offset shall return an error.
details: An access to an unmapped window offset shall return an error.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_apb_unmapped
details: Oracle: window 0x0 and 0xB–0xF error Coverage goal: all 6
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv, checks [N-7.19] window 0 and 0xC unmapped and a masked window 3 - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression; 2 of the 6 windows the plan lists. Note: in the chip map window 0 is now the SPI slave and window 11 the timers, so the plan's list (0x0 and 0xB to 0xF) is out of date; 0xC to 0xF are the unmapped ones.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_apb_slverr
details: Oracle: PSLVERR becomes an AHB ERROR and a precise fault
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv, checks [N-7.20] PSLVERR gives ERROR and the next access is OKAY - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Precise fault with the core: sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c (unmapped offset in every window), RESULT: PASSED.

NAME: t_apb_reset_skew
details: Oracle: AHB access during the hreset/preset gap is held, not falsely acked
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv, checks [N-9.2] hreadyout low while preset_n is asserted, [N-9.3] released after both resets, a_dual_reset_hold - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_apb_backtoback
details: Oracle: consecutive transfers to the same and different windows Coverage goal: same/different
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv, check 8 back-to-back writes all land, then read back (BRG-1) - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression; same window only, back-to-back transfers to different windows are not checked.

NAME: Assertions
details: From section 10 of the specification.

NAME: a_apb_setup
details: APB3 protocol: SETUP is exactly one cycle with PSEL and no PENABLE
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv (APB: PSEL one-hot, PENABLE only after a 1-cycle SETUP).

NAME: a_penable_needs_psel
details: PENABLE never asserts without PSEL
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv (APB: PSEL one-hot, PENABLE only after a 1-cycle SETUP).

NAME: a_psel_onehot
details: PSEL is one-hot or zero
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv (APB: PSEL one-hot ...).

NAME: a_apb_addr_stable
details: address and write data stable for the whole APB transfer
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Covered only by the APB slave models' own protocol check in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv (APB slave models saw no protocol error).

NAME: a_apb_wdata_stable
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Covered only by the APB slave models' own protocol check in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv.

NAME: a_capture_stable_at_phase
details: THE no-CDC property: the hclk-side capture is stable on the shared edge
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in a comment at rtl/ahb2apb/ahb2apb_bridge.v:45, no assertion.

NAME: a_pclk_on_hclk
details: every pclk edge coincides with an hclk edge (checked, not assumed)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in the specification only.

NAME: a_subword_no_apb
details: word-only: no APB transfer is ever generated for a sub-word access
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv (label a_subword_no_apb / a_unmapped, line 166).

NAME: a_subword_error
details: sub-word access returns ERROR
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv ([N-7.12]).

NAME: a_error_two_cycle
details: every error is exactly the AHB two-cycle sequence
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED in the bridge bench; the two-cycle ERROR is checked by the AHB protocol checker in tb/ahb/tb_ahb_interconnect.sv, where the bridge is a model.

NAME: a_timeout_at_16
details: timeout fires at exactly 16 and abandons the transfer
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv ([N-7.15]).

NAME: a_no_hang
details: timeout always terminates the AHB transfer: the bus cannot hang (R-7)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv (label a_no_hang, line 182).

NAME: a_unmapped
details: unmapped window asserts no PSEL and errors
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv (label a_subword_no_apb / a_unmapped, line 166; [N-7.19]).

NAME: a_slverr_prop
details: PSLVERR propagates as an AHB error
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv ([N-7.20]).

NAME: a_dual_reset_hold
details: hreadyout stays low until both resets have released (N-9.3)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv (label a_dual_reset_hold, line 195).

NAME: a_apb_div
details: APB_DIV: PENABLE held for the configured number of cycles
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/ahb2apb/tb_ahb2apb.sv (label a_apb_div, line 141).
